approval_reason: User approved continuing with the proposed Foundation backlog.

excluded: Git write operations, pull-request merge, and deployment
Bulk migration of every MDS role and prompt

milestones.name: Governed product boundary and artifact truth

tasks.title: Preserve and document the current repository baseline
acceptance_criteria: The current branch, HEAD, dirty paths, generated drift, runtime-data observation, and verification results are recorded.
No pre-existing user change is reset, overwritten, deleted, staged, or reformatted.
risks: The worktree can change after the baseline timestamp.

tasks.title: Restore generated structure consistency
acceptance_criteria: docs/STRUCTURE.generated.md is regenerated only through npm run docs:structure.
npm run validate:structure passes on the reviewed worktree.
risks: The generated diff may include unrelated uncommitted paths and requires human review before acceptance.

tasks.title: Obtain a reproducible Electron smoke disposition
acceptance_criteria: Smoke either passes with current UI/graph bridge assertions or has a reproducible environment/product defect with logs and owner.
A prior successful smoke report is not used as evidence for the current worktree.
risks: The managed Windows smoke subprocess requires --no-sandbox; production startup must never inherit that test-only switch.
A packaged Windows application smoke remains future release evidence.

tasks.title: Approve the MDS product boundary
acceptance_criteria: The human project authority accepts or rejects the six-core value chain and SHALL/SHALL NOT constraints.
The decision and rationale are recorded without AI self-approval.
risks: All downstream foundation work remains proposal-only until this scope gate is passed.

tasks.title: Approve artifact validity, lineage and Current Project Truth semantics
acceptance_criteria: Human authority accepts the separate lifecycle, validity, execution and lineage concepts.
Truth projection inclusion, warning and exclusion rules are explicitly decided.
risks: Ambiguous validity transitions can incorrectly exclude or trust project knowledge.

tasks.title: Accept the control-plane architecture decision
acceptance_criteria: The human architect selects an option and records consequences.
Read-only evidence adapters and managed-project write prohibition are architecturally explicit.
risks: Existing prompts and lifecycle descriptions remain inconsistent until migrated.

tasks.title: Migrate canonical foundation policy and minimum role contracts
acceptance_criteria: Canonical standards/schemas define approved validity and lineage rules without duplicating policy.
Only roles needed for Customer Change Analysis are migrated in this slice.
MIGRATION_MAP records every transitional prompt/role source and exit evidence.
risks: This changes approved governance and requires versioned replacements, not direct mutation.

tasks.title: Version the Customer Change Analysis workflow contract
acceptance_criteria: The workflow contract includes version creation, approval, impact traversal, validity review, truth refresh and context generation.
No step authorizes managed-project source mutation.
risks: Existing workflow YAML is approval-gated and must be versioned or explicitly replaced.

tasks.title: Implement immutable artifact version and approved-head transitions
tasks.next_action: FOUND-010 may begin from the approved lineage head and governed graph evidence.
acceptance_criteria: An approved artifact is never edited in place for a material change.
Approving a new version preserves history and leaves exactly one approved active head.
Approval evidence identifies actor, reason, timestamp and version.
risks: Windows filesystem replacement and stale-lock reclamation remain hardening risks; current implementation fails closed and records recovery evidence.

tasks.title: Traverse graph impact and propose downstream validity changes
acceptance_criteria: Impact is derived from governed graph relationships and retains path evidence.
The initial deterministic transition is limited to NEEDS_REVIEW unless stricter policy is approved.
Unrelated artifacts remain unchanged.
risks: Durable validity persistence and Current Project Truth remain scoped to FOUND-011.

tasks.title: Build the Current Project Truth projection and safe context package
acceptance_criteria: The projection applies approved inclusion, warning and exclusion rules deterministically.
The context package labels artifact authority/version and never presents draft, stale or conflicted content as truth.
Deleting the derived cache does not delete authoritative artifacts or history.
risks: Desktop UI wiring remains in FOUND-012; the context contract intentionally fails closed for non-authoritative artifacts.

tasks.title: Deliver desktop review, truth and impact interactions
acceptance_criteria: A human can edit a draft, submit review, approve/reject, inspect version history, see affected artifacts and inspect truth/context warnings.
Renderer consumes typed application operations and does not own truth or validity policy.
Accessibility and Electron security defaults remain intact.
risks: Browser-specific click-through automation was unavailable; the current smoke harness proves renderer boot and typed graph bridge only. In-app rich draft editing remains deferred.

tasks.title: Produce fresh Foundation Definition of Done evidence
acceptance_criteria: One source change is demonstrated through approval, lineage, impact, validity, truth and context package.
Fresh build, typecheck, validators, integration tests and desktop smoke evidence are recorded.
Managed-project source content is proven unchanged by MDS analysis.
Residual risks and release approval remain explicit.
risks: Release remains human approval-gated even when all technical checks pass.
